name: ai.mocop/mocop
title: mocop
description: Search APIs, MCP servers and agents; score a website's agent-readiness. Read-only, no auth.

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Search everything the index knows (APIs, MCP servers, A2A agents and the operations, tools and skills they expose) for what an agent needs to do. Use this first when you do not know which kind of thing you need. Supports field filters such as api:payment or op:refund method:POST.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (default 0).

protocol.description: Only entities that speak this protocol, e.g. rest, graphql, mcp or a2a. Optional; the protocol: filter in the query does the same.

query.description: What the agent needs to do, in plain words or with filters, e.g. "send an SMS" or "api:payment auth:oauth". Free words plus optional field filters. Words match names, descriptions and capability names (all words must match; falls back to any word). Filters: api:/mcp:/agent:<words> (scope to that kind and also match its operations/tools/skills), op:/endpoint:/tool:/skill:<words> (search inside operations, tools or skills), method:GET|POST|..., path:/v1/charges, group:<name>, domain:example.com, org:<slug or name>, auth:oauth|api_key|bearer|none, protocol:rest|graphql|mcp|a2a, verification:declared|observed|protocol_verified, verified:true, lang:fr, tag:<tag>. Prefix a word or filter with - to exclude it; use "quotes" for a phrase. Examples: `payment`, `api:payment auth:oauth`, `op:refund method:POST`, `mcp:calendar -auth:none`, `tool:search domain:github.com`. Searching all kinds.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get one API, MCP server or agent by slug: description, endpoint, auth, protocols, provenance and verification level (declared, observed or protocol_verified). Use after a search to inspect a result before using it.

slug.description: The entity's slug, as returned in search results (field `slug`), e.g. "mcp-hundily-com-63b5e97c".

tools.name: browse_organizations
tools.description: Browse indexed organizations (sites) and what each offers to agents. Use to explore by popularity or to list every site that offers an API, MCP server or agent.

has.description: Only organizations that offer this kind of thing: api, mcp or agent.

offset.description: Number of organizations to skip, for paging (default 0).

q.description: Optional filter on organization name or domain, e.g. "stripe". Leave empty to list everything.

sort.description: Sort order: popular (default, by popularity), capabilities (most operations/tools first) or name (A to Z).

tag.description: Only organizations tagged with this category slug, e.g. payments or maps-location. Get the list from list_tags.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the tags (categories such as payments, maps-location, ai-llm) with how many organizations and entities carry each. Use to explore what the index covers, then pass a slug as the tag argument of browse_organizations or as tag:<slug> in a search query. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Everything indexed for one organization: its APIs, MCP servers and agents, the discovery files found on its site (llms.txt, OpenAPI, agent card...) and its description. Use to see the whole picture of a site.

slug.description: The organization's slug, as returned by browse_organizations or search (field `slug`), e.g. "stripe".

tools.name: get_organization_items
tools.description: List an organization's APIs, MCP servers or agents, or fetch one of them. Use after get_organization when you want the details of one item.

item.description: Optional. The item's path slug when the organization has several of this kind (field `path` in results). Omit to list all.

kind.description: Which group to list: api, mcp, agents or site (documentation pages).

slug.description: The organization's slug, as returned by browse_organizations or search (field `slug`), e.g. "stripe".

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: List the operations, tools and skills of one API, MCP server or agent (paged). Use to find the exact call to make. Filter by group, kind, HTTP method or text; can show older versions or removed items.

group.description: Only items in this group or tag, exactly as listed in the response `groups`, e.g. "Billing".

method.description: Only REST operations with this HTTP method.

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for paging (default 0).

q.description: Words to find in item names, summaries, groups and paths, e.g. "refund".

removed.description: Include items that were removed in the latest crawl (default false).

slug.description: The entity's slug, as returned in search results (field `slug`), e.g. "mcp-hundily-com-63b5e97c".

sort.description: Sort order: group (default, as published), name (A to Z) or method.

version.description: Show the items as they were at this older version number (see get_entity_versions). Omit for the latest.

tools.name: get_entity_versions
tools.description: Version history of an API, MCP server or agent, or the list of changes in one version. Use to see what was added, changed or removed over time.

slug.description: The entity's slug, as returned in search results (field `slug`), e.g. "mcp-hundily-com-63b5e97c".

version.description: Return the changes introduced in this version number. Omit to list all versions.

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: Prefix suggestions for organization and entity names, for autocomplete. Returns at most a few matches per type.

query.description: The first letters or words the user has typed, e.g. "strip".

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question and get ranked matches with schema.org hints (NLWeb-style). Use when you want a few best answers rather than a filtered list.

query.description: The question or task in plain words, e.g. "which API can send SMS in Europe?".

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The guide for making a website agent-ready, as markdown: every signal mocop looks for and how to enable it. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: my_domains
tools.description: The signed-in user's claimed domains with verification instructions and latest readiness score. Requires sign-in. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: domain_dns_guide
tools.description: Where a claimed domain's DNS is hosted and the exact TXT record to publish to verify it. Requires sign-in.

domain.description: A bare domain name without scheme or path, e.g. "example.com". It must already be claimed with add_domain.

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Check the verification record for a claimed domain; a verified domain is queued for indexing. Requires sign-in.

domain.description: A bare domain name without scheme or path, e.g. "example.com". It must already be claimed with add_domain and its TXT record published.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Claim a domain you own; returns the DNS TXT record or file to publish for verification. Requires sign-in.

domain.description: A bare domain name without scheme or path, e.g. "example.com". Only claim domains you control.

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.description: The domains the signed-in user follows. Requires sign-in. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: favorite_domain
tools.description: Follow a domain so it appears in the user's favorites. Requires sign-in.

domain.description: A bare domain name without scheme or path, e.g. "example.com". The site to follow.

tools.name: unfavorite_domain
tools.description: Stop following a domain. Requires sign-in.

domain.description: A bare domain name without scheme or path, e.g. "example.com". The site to unfollow.

tools.name: analyze_site
tools.description: Score how agent-ready a website is (0-10) with per-area checks, recommendations and the discovered endpoints. Works for any public site, signed in or not. Results are cached for an hour.

domain.description: A bare domain name without scheme or path, e.g. "example.com". The site to analyze; it must be reachable over HTTPS.

tools.name: get_domain_discovery
tools.description: List everything indexed for a domain: its organization, APIs, MCP servers, agents and discovery files. Returns domain_not_indexed if we have nothing for it.

domain.description: A bare domain name without scheme or path, e.g. "example.com". The site to look up.
